items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: It was, so far I can remember it was John Robichaux was the violin and the leader. They had a lady by the name of Miss Kimmel and her husband was a trumpet player... I think it was old man Kimmel on the bass violin. Oh, Henry Kimmel.

ctx.x: You remember who else was in that band at that time?

It was, so far I can remember it was John Robichaux was the violin and the leader. They had a lady by the name of Miss Kimmel and her husband was a trumpet player. And I think, let's see, it was Alphonse Picou playing the clarinet. No, it was old man Charlie McCurtis.

items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I think it was old man Kimmel on the bass violin. ... all regular numbers from the, during the show days.

ctx.x: I think it was old man Kimmel on the bass violin. Oh, Henry Kimmel. Henry Kimmel. Well, all regular numbers from the, during the show days. I couldn't think of all of them by the name at present.
But it was, let's see, the shows used to come in once a week.
